items.title: RULING — a `Shared::read()` value still LIVE across a CALL that may write the cell: what should it read? Two cases — std's notify loops (a subscriber subscribes or unsubscribes during notify) and a read passed BY VALUE to a callee that writes the cell — JS aliases the storage, native copies it. B400 (scoped as ruled) copies when the read is a closure's `&`/`&mut` argument's result and when a `for` over `cell.read()` writes the cell in place; B418 copies a branch-chosen place; neither covers a write reached only through a call
items.discussion: solver-43 (2026-09-28); B400, B418 (closed on their landed halves); the 14 std notify goldens the blanket reading would move
items.body: Doors: (a) copy when the call can REACH an in-place write of that cell — needs a write summary per callee (an analysis pass; rec); (b) the blanket reading — any call counts — moves 14 std notify goldens and costs one array copy per notify; (c) leave the divergence documented. Rec (a). Sizing M; solver, Order 44.
